en.title: ProcureEase
en.subtitle: AI School Procurement Platform
en.description: Hong Kong school procurement platform with multi-stage tender workflow, supplier portal, audit center, and AI Assistant for spec and bid analysis.
en.features: 14 tender stages, 8 system roles, invite-only Postgres RBAC, spec/tender document generation, PDF extraction, local/cloud AI bid analysis.
en.role: Sole full-stack lead — architecture & ideation, DB RLS, AI integration, Express API.
en.result: Standardized procurement workflow for school administrators.

zh.title: ProcureEase
zh.subtitle: AI 學校採購平台
zh.description: 香港學校採購平台，多階段招標流程、審計中心，以及 AI Assistant 輔助規格與投標分析。
zh.features: 規格招標文件生成、PDF 提取、Local/Cloud AI 招標分析。
zh.role: 獨立全端負責人——架構想法構思、DB RLS、AI 整合、Express API。
zh.result: 為學校管理員標準化採購流程。

en.title: SENsights
en.subtitle: School-Hosted SEN Care Platform
en.description: SENsights is a school-hosted SEN (special educational needs) app for one school at a time. Staff keep student profiles, class lists, therapy records, goals, a training catalogue, and alerts (for example diet and medication) in one place, with access limited by role.
en.features: AI help (summaries, matching, catalogue translate) goes through a Node API — not the browser talking to the model directly. Student lists are always paged or searched; the app never loads the whole student table. Stack: React frontend, Supabase (auth, Sql DB, storage), and Sql DB triggers for notifications.
en.role: Full-stack delivery — React UI, Node AI API, Supabase auth & storage, Sql DB schema, triggers, and role-based access.
en.result: Production runs standalone (one school per deploy). A separate demo build supports multi-tenant trials only.

zh.title: SENsights
zh.subtitle: 學校自建 SEN 照顧平台
zh.description: SENsights 是每次服務一所學校的 SEN（特殊教育需要）應用。教職員可在同一平台管理學生檔案、班級名單、治療記錄、目標、訓練目錄及提醒（例如飲食、用藥），並按角色限制存取。
zh.features: AI 輔助（摘要、配對、目錄翻譯）經 Node API 處理，瀏覽器不直接呼叫模型。學生列表一律分頁或搜尋，不會一次載入整個學生表。技術棧：React 前端、Supabase（認證、Sql DB、儲存）及 Sql DB triggers 通知。
zh.role: 全端交付——React UI、Node AI API、Supabase 認證與儲存、Sql DB schema、triggers 及角色權限。
zh.result: 正式環境為 standalone（每校獨立部署）；另有 demo 版本僅供多租戶試用。

en.title: RAG Chat
en.subtitle: Enterprise Knowledge Search
en.description: Enterprise AI chat over Google Drive / OneDrive libraries — permission-scoped RAG keyed to Drive share rights per user email, not a flat document corpus.
en.features: n8n + Qdrant pipeline with directory ACLs (~60+ codes) mirroring Drive shares; React/Vite chat with attachments and markdown; async message polling.
en.role: Chat UI, database permissions & directory ACL editor, n8n workflow design, Qdrant filter architecture.
en.result: Staff query internal documents without retrieving chunks outside their Drive permissions.

zh.title: RAG Chat
zh.subtitle: 企業知識搜尋
zh.description: 企業 AI 對話，覆蓋 Google Drive / OneDrive 文件庫——按用戶電郵對應 Drive 分享權限做 RAG 檢索，而非扁平化全文索引。
zh.features: n8n + Qdrant 管道，目錄 ACL（60+ codes）對應 Drive 分享；React/Vite 對話介面（附件、Markdown）；非同步訊息輪詢。
zh.role: 對話 UI、資料庫權限與目錄 ACL 管理、n8n workflow 設計、Qdrant filter 架構。
zh.result: 員工可查詢內部文件，檢索結果不會超出其 Drive 權限範圍。

en.title: M365 Audit Tool
en.subtitle: SharePoint Audit Log Analytics
en.description: M365 SharePoint audit log analysis — CSV import (50+ columns), search with 14 indexes, access-rights reports, user groups, and Recharts compliance analytics.
en.features: Express API + Sql DB monorepo; 8 pages (AuditSearch, ImportData, Analytics, AccessRights, UserGroups, UserManagement); client-side CSV batch import.
en.role: Import pipeline, search UI, Express JWT auth layer, analytics dashboards.
en.result: IT admins can search, analyse access rights, and report on M365 audit activity at scale.

zh.title: M365 Audit Tool
zh.subtitle: SharePoint 審計日誌分析

zh.features: Express API + Sql DB monorepo；8 個頁面（搜尋、匯入、分析、存取權限、用戶群組、用戶管理）；客戶端 CSV 批次匯入。
zh.role: 匯入管道、搜尋 UI、Express JWT 認證層、分析儀表板。
zh.result: IT 管理員可大規模搜尋、分析存取權限及報告 M365 審計活動。
